title: Node.js Developer
description:
**Role Overview**

We are seeking a
**Node.js Backend Developer**
with
**4-7 years of experience**
to design, develop, and maintain secure, scalable backend applications and RESTful APIs. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in
**Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and JavaScript**
, along with hands-on experience in authentication, API integrations, and web security. This role involves building robust backend services, managing data models, and ensuring high application performance and reliability. The candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams and DevOps engineers to support CI/CD processes and deployment activities. Experience in modernizing legacy applications and following secure coding best practices is highly preferred.

**Timing:**
1:00 PM – 10:00 PM IST

**Work Mode:**
Remote

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and enhance backend services using
  **Node.js, JavaScript, and Express.js.**
* Own the design and maintenance of secure, scalable
  **REST APIs and middleware**
  .
* Model and manage data using
  **MongoDB and Mongoose**
  (schemas, indexes, queries, transactions).
* Implement and maintain authentication/authorization with JWT, secure cookies, sessions, roles, and permissions.
* Enforce secure coding practices: validation, error handling, logging, audit trails, and consistent API responses.
* Integrate with internal/external systems using Axios/HTTP clients, TLS/SSL, and API gateways (e.g., Azure API Management).
* Handle secure file upload/download flows (Busboy, MongoDB GridFS) with proper validation and sanitization.
* Write and maintain unit and integration tests using Jest; help improve test coverage and reliability.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Git, Artifactory, SonarQube, Fortify, Black Duck).
* Incrementally refactor and modernize legacy code while preserving business functionality.

**Mandatory Technical Skills & Experience:**

* Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and modern asynchronous JavaScript (Promises, async/await).
* Deep experience with Express.js (routing, middleware, validation, centralized error handling).
* Proven track record building and consuming RESTful APIs in production environments.
* Practical, hands-on experience with MongoDB and Mongoose.
* Experience implementing JWT-based authentication and role-based access control.
* Good understanding of web security: secure cookies, session management, CSRF, CORS, token lifecycle, and common vulnerabilities (OWASP).
* Experience integrating downstream APIs using Axios or similar HTTP clients.
* Experience with TLS/SSL certificates, timeouts, resilience patterns, and troubleshooting service-to-service communication.
* Experience writing unit tests with Jest, including mocks and async test cases.
* Working knowledge of Git workflows and CI/CD pipelines.

title: Software Dev Engineer II, Profit Intelligence
description:
**Description**
Are you interested in building intelligence systems from the ground up?
  
  
Are you interested in working with Applied Scientists, Big Data Engineers and Software Development Engineers to build large-scale data intelligence systems?
  
  
Are you interested to work in a team that positively impacts different key pillars of Amazon like Pricing, Promotions, Advertising, Auto inventory purchasing, Auto inventory removal, Inventory placement?
  
  
Are you interested in working for a team that builds cool systems yet has great work-life balance?
  
  
Profit intelligence systems measures, predicts true profit(/loss) for each item as a result of a specific shipment to an Amazon customer.
  
  
Prot Intelligence is all about providing intelligent ways for Amazon to understand profitability across retail business. What are the hidden factors driving the growth or profitability across millions of shipments each day?
  
  
Profit Intelligence provides these answers.
  
  
We compute the profitability of each and every shipment that gets shipped out of Amazon. Guess what, we predict the profitability of future possible shipments too. We are a team of agile, can-do engineers, who believe that not only are moon shots possible but that they can be done before lunch. All it takes is finding new ideas that challenge our preconceived notions of how things should be done. Process and procedure matter less than ideas and the practical work of getting stuff done. This is a place for exploring the new and taking risks.
  
  
We push the envelope in using cloud services in AWS as well as the latest in distributed systems, forecasting algorithms, and data mining.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to design and build AI-powered data platforms that transform large-scale business data into actionable insights. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and data engineering — owning end-to-end development of tools that help business leaders make faster, better decisions.
  
  
This is a high-impact role on a team where the software you ship directly shapes financial and operational strategy across Amazon.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Architect and build scalable platforms that ingest, process, and serve insights from petabyte-scale datasets
  
  
Integrate large language models and generative AI capabilities into internal analytics tools — enabling natural language querying, anomaly explanation, and automated reporting
  
  
Design ML pipelines for anomaly detection, forecasting, and trend analysis over structured and semi-structured business data
  
  
Partner with scientists, analysts, and PMs to translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped technical solutions
  
  
Drive engineering excellence: define coding standards, lead design reviews, and set the bar for operational health (monitoring, oncall, runbooks)
  
  
Mentor junior engineers; raise the technical capability of the team through clear documentation and code review
  
  
Own your services in production — you build it, you run it
  
  
Build and operate our foundational data infrastructure comprising of the entire spectrum of AWS Services - Storage (Redshift Data Shares, s3 data lakes), Orchestration (Step Functions, Glue and Internal Java Based Orchestration Tools), Processing (Spark & Flink - KDA), Streaming services (AWS Kinesis) and real-time large scale event aggregation stores.
  
  
Making it fully configurable and self-service for non-engineers.
  
  
Build and evolve tools that empower Amazonians to access data and build reliable, scalable and configurable way to generate Unit Economics for all Amazon Businesses. This includes UIs and frameworks for configuring rules, simulating their application, approval workows for rule changes, APIs and caching layers for high-throughput serving of Unit Economics Historicals and Predictions.
  
  
Build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like inhouse Reporting Applications and BI tools), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics.
  
  
You will be responsible for designing and building platforms for crunching 100s of TB of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- ADCI MAA 12 SEZ

**About DevRev**

*Computer*

You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 30% working directly with customers.
* Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
* Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
* Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
* Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
* Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
* Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
* Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 30% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
* Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
* Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
* Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
* Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
* Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
* Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

Taking a cloud-first, AI-enabled approach, we empower our global ZEOs with modern tools and self-service solutions that drive productivity, scalability, and agility - all while upholding the highest standards of security and compliance.
  
  
Within Corporate Operations, the G&A Business Applications team designs, implements, and optimizes the systems that power all of Zuora's core General & Administrative functions, including Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success (HR), and Legal. Reporting to the Senior Business Systems Manager of Digital Workplace Experience, this team works closely with system analysts, administrators, project managers, data architects, and developers to deliver robust, scalable business solutions.
  
  
The Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems is a senior technical expert and data architect responsible for designing, building, and securing enterprise-grade data structures and integrations across our corporate systems ecosystem. This role functions as a critical cross-functional data and system integration specialist, ensuring seamless data flow, robust security governance, and scalable automation across diverse business platforms (e.g., Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more).
  
  
You’ll join a collaborative, high-performing team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Your work will directly impact the efficiency, quality, and scalability of Zuora’s enterprise systems and digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION**
As a senior technical anchor supporting all G&A functions, the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems collaborates closely with leaders across Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal to establish a cohesive enterprise data architecture. You will build robust system integrations and leverage cutting-edge AI frameworks to drive efficiency, maximize data reliability, and enforce strict compliance across all internal platforms in alignment with strategic goals.
  
  
**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**
As the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems, you will play a vital role in the development, data architecture, and integration of Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal systems. Combining your expertise as a data architect and multi-platform integration specialist, you’ll ensure seamless data flow, scalable automation, and cross-system reliability without being tied to a single core vendor. title: Associate Specialist, Algorithm Research & Development
description:
**Company Overview**
KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
  
  
**Group/Division**
With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The LS-SWIFT Division of KLA’s Global Products Group provides patterned wafer inspection systems for high-volume semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to deliver market-leading cost of ownership in defect detection for a broad range of applications in the production of semiconductors. Customers from the foundry, logic, memory, automotive, MEMS, advanced packaging and other markets rely upon high-sample wafer inspection information generated by LS-SWIFT products. LS (Laser Scanning) systems enable cost-effective patterned wafer defect detection for the industry’s most sophisticated process technologies deployed in leading-edge foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND fabs. SWIFT (Simultaneous Wafer Inspection at Fast Throughput) systems deliver all-wafer-surface (frontside, backside, and edge) macro inspection that is critical for automotive IC, MEMS, and advanced packaging processes as well as foundry/logic and memory fabs. LS-SWIFT operates from a global footprint that includes the US, Singapore, India and Germany, and serves a worldwide customer base across Asia, Europe and North America.
  
  
**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**

* Designing, developing, modifying and diagnosing complex ML and DL algorithms
* Ability to invent, prototype and deploy new image processing algorithms and ideas
* Hands-on experience in object-oriented and functional programming
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work both independently and in a team environment.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Doctorate (Academic) Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 6 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 8 years
  
  

* Strong background in one or more of the following areas: machine Learning, deep learning, computer vision, image processing
* Familiar with one of common deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch
* Hands-on experience with training ML/AI models that have been deployed in a product
* Ability to write model architectures from scratch, modify loss functions

Our Cyber Risk practice helps organizations with the management of information and technology risks by delivering end-to-end solutions using proven methodologies and tools in a consistent manner. Our services help organizations address, in a timely manner, pervasive issues such as identity theft, data security breaches, data leakage, cyber security, and system outages across organizations of various sizes and industries with the goal of enabling ongoing, secure, and reliable operations across the enterprise.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Developer / Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in the Security Incident Response (SIR) module. The ideal candidate will have 3+ years of ServiceNow platform development experience, including at least 2 years focused specifically on implementing and managing Security Incident Response solutions. This role will be responsible for configuring, customizing, integrating, and automating the ServiceNow SIR lifecycle to support incident intake, triage, investigation, containment, remediation, and reporting.
  
  
**Work you will do**
As a
**Consultant / Senior Consultant**
, you would be expected to perform the following activities:
  
  

* Well versed with the application deployment and configuration baselines, and understanding of how the application environment operates in a secure environment and how exceptions are handled during operations.
* Facilitate use of technology-based tools or methodologies to continuously improve the monitoring, management, and reliability of the service.
* Define the architecture and design elements for the implementation of ServiceNow SecOps solution including design data/object models, technical workflow diagrams, access control models, and integration patterns.
* Understand the business requirement and define & document epics, user stories, create UI mock-ups, and have a roll-up-the-sleeves approach to make things happen.
* Facilitate ServiceNow training and support teams on complex system configuration.
* Collaborate with clients to resolve business problems by translating functional requirements into technical solutions.
* Be responsible for end-to-end application design, workflow configurations, and customizations.
* Demonstrate good judgment and a pragmatic approach to delivering a solution that optimizes architecture activities across company needs, business constraints, and technological realities.

**Key Responsibilities (Security Incident Response)**

* Configure and administer ServiceNow Security Incident Response including security incident categories, playbooks, assignment rules, severity/priority models, SLAs, notifications, and response tasking.
* Design and support incident intake and triage workflows from multiple security sources such as SIEM, SOAR, threat intelligence, email security, EDR/XDR, vulnerability tools, and manual submissions.
* Integrate and maintain ingestion from security tools into the ServiceNow SIR application and validate data mapping, transformation logic, schedules, deduplication, and error handling.
* Build and maintain automations using Flow Designer / Integration Hub for enrichment, routing, approvals, escalations, containment support, evidence gathering, and closure activities.
* Configure incident lifecycle processes covering detection, analysis, triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.
* Partner with SOC, IR, IT Ops, app owners, and resolver groups to coordinate response workflows, manage dependencies, and ensure timely incident remediation.
* Define and publish dashboards / KPIs in ServiceNow for incident aging, MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, incident trends, severity distribution, and analyst workload.
* Support governance through audit-ready evidence, documentation, runbooks, access controls, and change / release management.
* Enable linkage between security incidents, vulnerable items, change records, problems, and CMDB CIs to improve traceability and operational response.
* Support development of response playbooks and standard operating procedures aligned to enterprise incident management and cyber response requirements.

**Optional Responsibilities (Vulnerability Response)**
Support integration points between Vulnerability Response and SIR, including creation of security incidents from exploited or high-risk vulnerabilities when needed.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* 3-10 years of ServiceNow experience (Admin/Developer/Platform).
* Hands-on experience implementing or operating ServiceNow Security Incident Response.
* Strong understanding of the security incident management lifecycle and SOC / IR operating processes.
* Experience with CMDB / asset data concepts and how they affect SIR accuracy, ownership, prioritization, and routing.
* Working knowledge of integrations (REST / API; MID Server where applicable) and automation (Flow Designer).
* Understanding incident prioritization, case handling, escalation models, and response coordination across stakeholders.

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* ServiceNow CSA (Mandatory), CAD and CIS-SIR/SecOps-related CIS-certifications.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with SIEM / SOAR / EDR platforms.
* Scripting (ServiceNow JavaScript), performance tuning, and large-scale data ingestion.

**Core Skills**
ServiceNow SIR, SecOps, CMDB, Flow Designer / Integration Hub, integrations, reporting / dashboards, security incident lifecycle, stakeholder coordination, communication, and presentation.
  
  
**Education:**

* Bachelor’s/ Master’s degree in information technology or related field

**Location:**

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

description:
The Applications Development Senior Programmer Analyst is an intermediate level position responsible for participation in the establishment and implementation of new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to contribute to applications systems analysis and programming activities.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Conduct tasks related to feasibility studies, time and cost estimates, IT planning, risk technology, applications development, model development, and establish and implement new or revised applications systems and programs to meet specific business needs or user areas
* Monitor and control all phases of development process and analysis, design, construction, testing, and implementation as well as provide user and operational support on applications to business users
* Utilize in-depth specialty knowledge of applications development to analyze complex problems/issues, provide evaluation of business process, system process, and industry standards, and make evaluative judgement
* Recommend and develop security measures in post implementation analysis of business usage to ensure successful system design and functionality
* Consult with users/clients and other technology groups on issues, recommend advanced programming solutions, and install and assist customer exposure systems
* Ensure essential procedures are followed and help define operating standards and processes
* Serve as advisor or coach to new or lower level analysts
* Has the ability to operate with a limited level of direct supervision.
* Can exercise independence of judgement and autonomy.
* Acts as SME to senior stakeholders and /or other team members.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

**Recommended Qualifications:**

* 5-8 years of relevant experience
* Experience in systems analysis and programming of software applications
* Experience in managing and implementing successful projects
* Working knowledge of consulting/project management techniques/methods
* Ability to work under pressure and manage deadlines or unexpected changes in expectations or requirements

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience

This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.
  
  
The Senior Reconciliation Developer – Assistant Vice President (AVP / C12) is a hands-on technical individual contributor responsible for the end-to-end design, development, configuration, and optimization of enterprise-grade data reconciliations and automated control pipelines.
  
  
Operating with a high level of technical autonomy, the incumbent drives reconciliation engineering across high-throughput transaction processing systems, general ledger architectures, and centralized data distribution platforms. The role serves as a key technical subject matter expert (SME) delivering robust risk controls, automated break classification logic, and scalable data pipelines for strategic initiatives including enterprise finance automation, Target Operating Model (TOM) expansion across Capital Markets, and mandatory control onboarding for 200+ critical application feeds.
  
  
Hybrid Schedule: 2 or 3 full days per week on-site in the office, with remaining days worked remotely in accordance with enterprise hybrid work policies.
  
  
End-to-End Rule Build & Configuration: Design, build, test, and deploy complex multi-way matching algorithms, tolerance rules, and automated adjustment logic on enterprise reconciliation engines (e.g., TLM SmartStream, Duco, Gresham, or proprietary enterprise matching engines).
  
  
Break Classification & Exception Handling: Engineer automated break classification and triage models to categorize discrepancies, assign break ownership, and accelerate root-cause analysis.
  
  
Scalable Data Pipeline Development: Develop and optimize high-throughput data extraction, transformation, and ingestion pipelines using Python (Advanced), SQL (Advanced), and Apache Spark / PySpark for large-scale financial and transactional datasets.
  
  
Technical Specification & BRD Translation: Partner with business analysts, operations teams, and product owners to translate Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) into detailed technical designs, data mapping specifications, and schema definitions.
  
  
Data Sourcing & Lineage Verification: Validate data integrity, provenance, and transformation logic from upstream Systems of Record (SoRs) into central data distribution hubs and analytical repositories.
  
  
Backlog Remediation Execution: Systematically analyze, develop, and deploy automated reconciliation solutions to clear active request backlogs (340+ scheduled and ad-hoc requests).
  
  
DevOps & Containerized Deployment: Package and deploy services utilizing Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift container platforms; maintain automated CI/CD build and test pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, Bitbucket/GitLab).

This role offers a unique opportunity to collaborate across services, design and propose new architectures or modify existing ones, and drive the right technical trade-offs between short-term and long-term concerns. You will navigate significant complexity while building features that require changes across various services and pages, including eBooks purchase and store experiences for digital products. * You will play a key role in defining the architecture for software using a wide range of technologies, programming languages and systems.

* You will interface with product manager & stakeholders to understand the business requirements.
* You will author detailed design covering process/data flow diagrams, key trade-offs, technology & cost considerations that you will review with your team’s SDEs/Sr. SDEs as well as impacted upstream/downstream interface SDEs/Sr. SDEs to incorporate feedback resulting in well thought out high quality designs.

* You will actively engage in operational support for your team, and ensure that the root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved.
* You don’t settle for the status quo, and routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve your team’s operations.
* We embrace the challenges of a fast paced market and evolving technologies and making decisions to provide the best buying experience to our customers.
* You will be encouraged to see the big picture, be innovative, and positively impact millions of customers.
* Successful candidates for this position will have a background in Java or C++. Equally important to these specific skills is a candidate's ability to multi-task, adapt quickly to new development environments and changing business requirements, learn new systems, gain new skills, create reliable & maintainable code, and find creative, scalable solutions to difficult problems.

**Description**
Amazon Kindle is a revolutionary reading device and one of the most innovative devices at Amazon.
  
  
Our Organization is looking for an inventive and technically skilled Software Development Engineer to join our diverse team at the forefront of delighting millions of readers around the world. We build the next generation reading experience. Our team works backwards from customers by understanding their needs to design and implement solutions that deliver an immersive reading experience across a wide variety of devices, genres, and formats.
  
  
We are looking for full-stack Software Development Engineers who enjoys building high quality software that touches millions of customers. Those who seek a challenge, are eager to learn, and want to make a impact on global customers should apply.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
The Software Engineer will contribute to the definition, development, integration, test, documentation, and support of Java, C++ and ReactNative software across multiple digital surfaces for Kindle Readers and Applications. This hands-on position will engage your engineering capabilities and technical knowledge of software development while developing experience successfully planning, organizing, and conducting software development projects in a dynamic environment.
  
  

* Responsible for the architecture of software solutions, working with and improving on current limitations and compatibilities between subsystems, building new concepts and methodology, and the development of major routines and utilities.
* Designing and Building new features that are highly performant
* Preparation of technical requirements and software design specifications.
* Understanding the internals of graphics subsystems.
* Instilling best practices for software development and documentation, making sure designs meet requirements, and delivering high quality software on tight schedules.

A day in the life
  
  
In the course of a typical day, an SDE in Amazon team can:
  
  

* ship and review C++, ReactNative or Java for reading features on Kindle E-Reader
* collaborate with peers, product owners, UX designers and partner tech teams on architecture and design of reading features.
* adapt the customer experience for the next generation of Kindle E-Reader devices focusing on operational excellence, monitoring the team's code deployment pipelines and dashboards
* root cause issues and propose solutions
* train new team-mates on how E-Reader and Kindle Application software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture.

**About The Team**
We own the design, architecture, and implementation of a surface to enable reading innovation across file formats and operating systems. Our software supports Kindle customers on all major mobile surfaces and Kindle devices. Our engineers enjoy working as a team and welcome the opportunity to lead whenever possible.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Responsibilities: - Build the canonical billing and entitlement ledger design and implement an append-only, journals-as-truth Postgres schema (orders, signed payments ledger, dated entitlement grants, gap-free per-entity invoice numbering) where all state is a derived view and every entitlement traces to a paid order line. - Own the full subscription lifecycle in code: purchase, renewal, resubscription, upgrade/downgrade/switch, proration, trials, cancellation, and lapse across both Stripe and Razorpay, ending the renewal/resubscription bugs that lose money and entitlements today. - Build the gateway ingest pipeline: idempotent, replay-safe webhook handling for Stripe, Razorpay, and Apple notifications, normalized into the ledger with dead-letter handling and reconciliation that proves the gateway and our books agree every day. - Handle the hard money paths: refunds, chargebacks/disputes, credits, and partial/zero-amount settlements, with signed lines that allocate the gateway-charged amount correctly and never double-count. - Produce clean financial and entitlement data and the views that feed accounting close (revenue recognition, multi-entity GST/IGST and US tax, deferred revenue), exchange reporting (CME and Indian exchanges), and conversion/retention analytics. - Own the user billing surface end-to-end: the user cabinet and checkout (TypeScript/Astro/React) where customers buy, upgrade, manage, and cancel so the experience and the ledger never disagree. - Migrate the live business safely, backfill historical payments with documented confidence tiers, run the new system in parallel against the legacy CouchDB account model, prove reconciliation is clean, and then cut over read and write paths region by region. Requirements: - 6-10 years of backend engineering, with deep Go and strong relational data modeling and SQL; you design schemas that stay correct under concurrency and scale. - You have built or rebuilt payments, subscriptions, and ledgers end-to-end: payment-gateway integration, idempotent webhooks, the subscription lifecycle (renewals, proration, upgrades, cancellation, and dunning), and refunds and disputes. This is the core of the job, not an adjacent skill. - The full money-systems depth that surrounds a ledger is required, not optional: reconciliation (gateway books), revenue recognition and tax (e. g., GST/IGST, ASC 606 or equivalent), financial/exchange reporting, and event-sourced/append-only ledger design (journals-as-truth, derived state, signed entries). - Experience building or owning a B2B product where billing and entitlement complexity is real (metering, plans/add-ons, multi-tenant or partner billing). GoCharting also runs a /b2b and white-label surface. - SQL fluency to interrogate money data yourself; you can find the row that explains the discrepancy, not just file a ticket. - Comfortable in a TypeScript/React frontend to own the user cabinet and checkout end-to-end (you don't need to be a frontend specialist, but you ship the surface that touches your ledger). - In-person in our Chennai office; this role works too closely with Finance, the CTO, and the live money flow to be remote. Nice-to-Haves: - Prior fintech or trading domain is genuinely good to have, but not required: billing correctness is domain-agnostic, and the market's context is learnable on the job - EU VAT/OSS, multi-entity, or multi-currency billing experience. - AWS Cognito / identity at scale, or prior work untangling a legacy data model during a live migration. - Experience standing up reconciliation, finance-close, or revenue-reporting pipelines that accountants actually trusted. - Top-tier Indian institution (IIT/NIT/IIM) nice-to-have, not a gate. Company Summary GoCharting is a web-native, multi-asset order flow trading platform trusted by more than 2 million registered traders globally. The platform brings professional-grade trading tools, including footprint and cluster charts, depth of market (DOM), volume profile, market profile, cumulative delta, imbalance analytics, time and sales, options analytics, alerts, scripting, broker connectivity, and real-time market data into a browser-based product with companion mobile apps. GoCharting serves active retail and professional traders across futures, options, stocks, forex, crypto, and commodities through a freemium SaaS model with premium subscriptions and market data add-ons. GoCharting began with a trader's obsession, an open-source library, and a GitHub conversation across two continents. Why Join Us GoCharting is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. GoCharting is an async-friendly team of engineers, traders, and product builders on a mission to give every trader on earth access to institutional-grade tools. We're backed, growing fast, and looking for exceptional people!

title: Distinguished, Software Engineering
description:
Role Summary
  
  
As a Distinguished Engineer in Walmart's Data & AI Organization, you are one of the most senior technical leaders responsible for defining the long-term architecture, strategy, and execution of enterprise-scale data, AI, and software platforms. You combine deep expertise in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, AI Platforms, Security, Governance, and Enterprise Architecture to build trusted, scalable, and AI-ready systems that power Walmart's customer, associate, and business experiences globally.
  
  
You operate with Executive-level influence, driving cross-organizational technology decisions, shaping engineering standards, and solving the most complex technical and business challenges. You are expected to be hands-on, leading architectural design, reviewing code, guiding platform strategy, driving security and compliance by design, and mentoring senior technical talent across the organization.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
Enterprise Data & AI Strategy
  
  
Define and execute the multi-year technology vision for Data, AI, Agentic AI, Analytics, Real-Time Platforms, and Customer Data ecosystems.
  
  
Align platform strategy with Walmart's enterprise AI, data governance, privacy, cybersecurity, and business objectives.
  
  
Drive standardization, platformization, and modernization initiatives across multiple product and engineering organizations.
  
  
Architecture & Platform Leadership
  
  
Architect global-scale data and software platforms supporting batch, streaming, AI/ML, Agentic AI, and real-time processing workloads.
  
  
Design highly scalable, secure, resilient, and observable systems spanning Data Lakes, Data Products, APIs, Microservices, Event-Driven Architectures, and AI and Agentic Platforms.
  
  
Serve as the final technical authority on complex architectural decisions affecting multiple organizations and markets.
  
  
Security, Governance & Trust
  
  
Champion security-by-design, privacy-by-design, and responsible AI principles across platforms and products.
  
  
Establish enterprise standards for identity, access management, data governance, lineage, compliance, risk mitigation, and operational resilience.
  
  
Partner with Information Security, Privacy, Legal, and Infrastructure teams to ensure platforms meet regulatory and enterprise requirements.
  
  
Engineering Excellence
  
  
Raise the engineering bar across Data Engineering and Software Engineering disciplines.
  
  
Drive adoption of modern engineering practices including DevSecOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, Observability, Reliability Engineering, Testing Automation, and AI-assisted development.
  
  
Lead architecture reviews, code reviews, design reviews, and operational excellence initiatives
  
  
AI & Innovation Leadership
  
  
Enable enterprise-scale AI and Agentic AI capabilities through reusable platforms, metadata foundations, governance frameworks, evaluation systems, and secure integration patterns.
  
  
Drive innovation in areas such as intelligent automation, AI-ready data platforms, knowledge systems, and next-generation engineering productivity tools.
  
  
Influence the adoption of emerging technologies while balancing risk, scalability, maintainability, and business value.
  
  
Organizational Leadership
  
  
Mentor Principal, Staff, and Senior Engineers across the organization.
  
  
Build strong technical communities, promote knowledge sharing, and develop future engineering leaders.
  
  
Foster a culture of innovation, inclusion, continuous learning, and operational excellence.
  
  
What You’ll Bring
  
  
15+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Distributed Systems, or Enterprise Architecture.
  
  
Proven expertise building and operating large-scale data platforms, real-time systems, and cloud-native applications.
  
  
Deep understanding of enterprise data architecture, AI/ML platforms, security architecture, governance, and software engineering best practices.
  
  
Strong hands-on coding experience in Java, Scala, Python, SQL, and modern cloud technologies.
  
  
Demonstrated success leading enterprise-wide architecture and platform transformations.
  
  
Experience influencing senior executives and driving alignment across large engineering organizations without direct authority.
  
  
Proven track record of mentoring senior technical leaders and scaling engineering excellence.
  
  
Experience building enterprise Data & AI platforms supporting analytics, personalization, customer intelligence, optimization, and Agentic AI solutions.
  
  
Expertise in data platform modernization, platform engineering, security engineering, and cloud transformation.
  
  
Experience operating across global markets and highly regulated environments.
  
  

* Contributions to patents, publications, open-source projects, or industry thought leadership. Previous experience as a Chief Architect, Distinguished Engineer, Fellow, or equivalent senior technical leadership role.

**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Work
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Chennai office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
Belonging
  
  
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
  
  
At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
  
  
Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
Walmart, Inc., is an Equal Opportunities Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.

title: Integration Engineer - Mediation

We are looking for a highly skilled Telecom Mediation Specialist with strong expertise in the deployment, integration, configuration, development, and troubleshooting of Telecom Mediation platforms.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience on deployment of Mediation Platform across Bare Metal, Virtualized, Cloud, or Containerized environments, with a strong understanding of CDR processing, Online protocol knowledge, data transformation, mediation rules, network-element integration, and upstream/downstream systems.
  
  
Experience with automation, Kafka/real-time streaming, cloud technologies, and Gen-AI tools will be an added advantage.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Deploy, install, configure, upgrade, and troubleshoot mediation platforms across Bare Metal, VM, Cloud, and Container/Kubernetes environments.
* Configure and manage mediation workflows for high-volume CDR processing.
* Integrate mediation platforms with various Network, IT, Core, Packet Core, Charging, Billing, and downstream systems.
* Design and develop mediation solutions for Charging & Billing, IMS/VoLTE, 4G, and 5G use cases.
* Perform end-to-end data reconciliation across network elements, mediation, and downstream systems.
* Develop and maintain mediation components, utilities, scripts, and automation frameworks.
* Use Java, C, Python, Shell, and/or Perl for development and automation activities.
* Build, deploy, and develop real-time streaming applications using Apache Kafka or Apache Flink.
* Explore and leverage Gen-AI tools to improve engineering productivity, troubleshooting, automation, and solution development.
* Strong hands-on experience with telecom mediation platforms such as Ericsson Mediation OR Nokia/Comptel Mediation OR Amdocs Mediation/Oracle RBM
* Strong understanding of CDR structures, processing flows, mediation rules, parsing, transformation, and enrichment.
* Experience in end-to-end mediation solution design/development for Charging & Billing, IMS/VoLTE, and/or 5G.
* Thorough understanding of ASN.1/JSON/AVRO Schema/Parquet structures.
* Strong proficiency in SQL.
* Hands-on experience with Java, C, Python, or equivalent programming languages.
* Experience with data parsing, transformation, ETL processes, and API integrations.
* Strong understanding of large-scale data processing.
* Experience in building, deploying, configuring, or troubleshooting Apache Kafka / Apache Flink environments.
* Understanding of real-time/event-driven streaming architectures.
* Experience developing real-time streaming applications using Kafka is highly desirable.

**The skills you bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* 5–12 years of relevant experience in Telecom Mediation deployment, development, integration, or solution engineering.

title: Principal Architect - Payments & Ledger
description:
YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions - YouTrip and YouBiz - empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum's Global Innovator 2025, CNBC's World's Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn's Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions. 

Job Description: Principal Architect, Payments & Ledger

You'll own the architectural direction for money movement end to end: multi-currency wallets and balances, the core ledger, card issuing and authorisation, in-app FX, overseas transfers and payouts, treasury and pre-funding, settlement and reconciliation, and the shared platform services underneath them. Your remit covers both YouTrip (consumer) and YouBiz (business), across every market we operate in.

Responsibilities:

* The Ledger - Double-entry design, chart of accounts, sub-ledger boundaries, immutability and correction rules, multi-currency representation, precision and rounding policy, and how balances are derived or stored. You'll define how we handle authorisation holds, reversals, partial and incremental captures, refunds, FX revaluation and unreconciled positions, and you'll be able to explain and defend those choices to Finance, auditors and regulators
* Money movement correctness -  Idempotency, exactly-once outcomes on top of at-least-once messaging, clear state machines for every transaction type, and well-defined failure, retry, timeout and compensation paths. For every integration, the question "what happens if the partner succeeds and we fail?" should have a written answer that you own
* Card issuing - Architecture for authorisation, clearing and settlement as a Mastercard Principal Member, including real-time authorisation on the scheme's critical path, stand-in processing, authorisation expiry, disputes and chargebacks, tokenisation for Apple Pay and Google Pay, virtual and physical card lifecycle, and the strict latency and availability targets that come with it
* FX and multi-currency wallets - Rate sourcing, quoting and rate locking, spread and exposure management, in-app currency exchange across our wallet currencies, and pre-funding and liquidity models that keep customers' balances safe and available
* Cross-border transfers - Corridor architecture, payout rail integrations (local real-time rails, bank transfers, SWIFT and partner networks), pre-funding and nostro design, and sanctions and AML screening built in as a core design constraint, not an afterthought
* Reconciliation and settlement - We treat reconciliation as an architecture problem, not an operations task. You'll design systems where breaks are rare, spotted within minutes, and traceable to a clear cause, across multiple time zones, currencies and partners
* Non-functional requirements - Latency, throughput, availability and cost as design targets with numbers attached. Clear, written decisions on where eventual consistency is acceptable and where it isn't. Recovery, replay and backfill as built-in capabilities
* Standards and technical judgement - Engineering and coding standards, architecture reviews for significant changes, and architecture documentation that engineers actually build from. You'll write decision records that capture the reasoning and the options rejected, and keep them current
* Partners and vendors - Technical evaluation and ongoing oversight of card processors, scheme connectivity, banking and settlement partners, FX liquidity providers, payout partners, KYC and screening vendors, and core infrastructure. You'll know their systems' failure modes as well as their own architects do
* Growing technical leaders - You'll mentor tech leads and senior engineers from day one and lead mostly through influence. As the function matures, you'll build and lead a small architecture group

**Requirements**

* Deep payments and ledger experience (essential) - You've designed or substantially rebuilt a production financial ledger. You can speak from real experience about journal design, posting models, balance consistency and correction strategies, including what happens when they go wrong
* Card issuing expertise - Hands-on experience with card scheme integrations (ideally Mastercard), issuer processing, authorisation flows, clearing files, and disputes
* A builder, not just an advisor - You've written production code at scale, and your work sits behind systems that handled real traffic and real money. Your authority comes from having shipped
* Range from system to field level - You're equally comfortable designing distributed settlement flows and deciding the type and precision of a single amount field, often in the same week
* Regulated-environment fluency - Experience with safeguarding and customer fund segregation, payment and e-money licensing, data residency, auditability and technology risk requirements, ideally including MAS and other Asia Pacific regulators. You design ahead of regulatory and scheme changes instead of reacting to them
* Multi-market experience - You've built systems that operate across several countries, currencies and regulators at once
* Strong writing - Clear, structured, opinionated documents that remain useful long after the meeting ends. Documentation is part of the work, not a follow-up task
* Opinions you can defend - Clear positions on design patterns, standards and trade-offs, explained just as well to a new graduate as to the board
* Credibility with partners - You can tell when a vendor's recommendation serves them more than us, and you can make that case with evidence
* Experience with Golang, event-driven architectures and cloud-native infrastructure is a plus

What This Role Is Not

This isn't a diagramming role, and it isn't a review gate that approves other people's work without contributing to it. It's also not an engineering management role with large headcount or delivery ownership, though its influence is comparable. If you're looking to run a large organisation, we have other roles for that.

What You Can Expect From Us

* The chance to shape the core money platform of Asia Pacific's leading multi-currency wallet, used by millions of people and businesses
* Some of the most interesting payments challenges in the region, across multiple markets, currencies, partners and regulators
* A company that is committed to getting the architecture right, not just shipping fast
* A culture that values technical craft, direct feedback and getting things done

To Apply

If you're interested in this role, click Apply Now and send us your CV. Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Internship Program 2026 - Build Your Career Through Real Project Experience
description:
**Job Description**
Launch Your Career with Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited
  
  
**Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited**
is inviting applications from
**2026 graduates**
and a limited number of
**2025 graduates**
for our
**2027 project expansion plans**
.
  
  
We are looking for passionate, self-motivated individuals who aspire to build a successful career by gaining practical industry experience through real-time software development and business projects.
  
  
**Internship Opportunities Are Available In The Following Departments**

* MERN Stack Development
* Software Testing (Manual & Automation)
* Executive Assistant
* Product Design (UI/UX)
* Human Resources (HR)
* DevOps
* IT Support

This internship is designed for candidates who believe that
**knowledge, practical exposure, discipline, and continuous improvement are the foundation of a successful career.**
Unlike conventional training programs, this is a
**real-time industry learning opportunity**
where interns gain hands-on experience by working alongside experienced professionals on live projects.
  
  
Who Should Apply?
  
  
**This Internship Is Ideal For Candidates Who**

* Have graduated in 2026 or are selected from the 2025 graduate batch.
* Are interested in building a career in the ERP and business software domain.
* Are passionate about learning and building a long-term professional career.
* Are willing to learn through practical implementation rather than classroom training.
* Want genuine industry exposure through real-time projects.
* Are self-motivated and committed to continuous learning and improvement.
* Are willing to accept feedback and continuously improve their performance.
* Are prepared to demonstrate their knowledge and skills through practical work and assessments.
* Value knowledge, discipline, professional growth, and long-term career development.

**This program is not intended for candidates whose primary expectation is immediate stipend or salary.**
Our primary objective is to develop skilled professionals who are capable of building successful long-term careers through continuous learning, practical industry experience, discipline, and proven performance.
  
  
Who Should Not Apply?
  
  
Please carefully understand the nature of this opportunity before applying.
  
  
**Candidates Should Not Apply If They**

* Are not interested in the ERP domain or business software industry.
* Expect an immediate stipend or salary from the beginning of the internship.
* Are primarily looking for a paid internship rather than a performance-based learning opportunity.
* Are looking for an internship only to obtain a certificate.
* Are not willing to undergo strong assessments at every stage.
* Are not comfortable with performance-based continuation.
* Are looking only to complete the internship duration without focusing on learning and performance.
* Are not willing to continuously improve their knowledge and practical skills.
* Are not interested in proving their capabilities through actual work and performance.
* Are not interested in a potential long-term employment opportunity with the organization.
* Are unwilling to take ownership, accept feedback, maintain discipline, and demonstrate professional commitment.

Important
  
  
**This opportunity is not designed for candidates who are looking only for a certificate, immediate payment, or a short-term internship experience.**
**Certification is not guaranteed merely for joining or attending the program.**
This opportunity is for candidates who are genuinely willing to:
  
  
**Learn → Practice → Perform → Improve → Prove Themselves → Build a Career**
If you are genuinely interested in the ERP domain, willing to invest your time and effort in learning, and want to prove yourself through performance with the possibility of securing a
**Fresher employment opportunity**
, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
Nature of the Internship
  
  
This internship follows a
**Self-Learning with Industry Mentorship Model.**
**Candidates Will Be Expected To**

* Learn independently with guidance from mentors.
* Complete assigned learning modules and project tasks.
* Work on real client and internal projects.
* Take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* Continuously improve technical and professional skills.
* Demonstrate discipline, professionalism, and accountability throughout the program.
* Accept feedback positively and implement improvements.
* Demonstrate consistent performance throughout the internship.

Success in this internship depends largely on the candidate's willingness to learn, adapt, take responsibility, and consistently perform.
  
  
Selection Process
  
  
Stage 1 – Five-Day Assessment Program
  
  
Before being admitted into the internship program, every applicant must successfully complete a
**5-working-day assessment**
.
  
  
During this assessment, candidates will be assigned practical tasks to evaluate not only technical aptitude but also professional qualities.
  
  
**The Evaluation Includes**

* Learning ability
* Problem-solving approach
* Discipline and punctuality
* Sincerity and commitment
* Professional ethics
* Ownership and accountability
* Communication skills
* Adaptability
* Consistency in task completion
* Overall suitability for the internship program

Only candidates who successfully complete this assessment will be offered internship positions.
  
  
Internship Structure and Stipend Eligibility
  
  
The internship will be for
**150 working days**
, divided into
**six blocks of 25 working days each**
.
  
  
Block Duration Stipend Blocks 1–3 75 working days
**No stipend**
Block 4 25 working days ₹5,000\* Block 5 25 working days ₹5,000\* Block 6 25 working days ₹5,000\*
**Total**
**150 working days**
**Up to ₹15,000**
\*
  
  
Stipend eligibility is directly connected to the candidate's performance and successful progression through the internship blocks.
  
  
**Candidates Who Successfully Progress To**
**Block 4 → ₹5,000 stipend**
**Block 5 → ₹5,000 stipend**
**Block 6 → ₹5,000 stipend**
will be eligible for the applicable stipend only after satisfying the required performance standards for the respective block.
  
  
The organization reserves the right to determine stipend eligibility based on the candidate's performance assessment.
  
  
Block-Wise Performance Assessment
  
  
At the end of
**every 25-working-day block**
, candidates will undergo a
**strict performance assessment**
.
  
  
**Each Assessment Will Evaluate**

* Technical learning progress
* Practical implementation skills
* Quality of work
* Discipline and attendance
* Professional behaviour
* Ownership of responsibilities
* Ability to improve based on feedback
* Team collaboration
* Communication
* Problem-solving ability
* Commitment towards career development
* Overall performance

**Candidates who successfully clear the assessment will be allowed to continue to the next block.**
Candidates who do not meet the required standards may be discontinued from the internship and will not be allowed to progress to the next block.
  
  
Performance-Based Continuation
  
  
Continuation in the internship is
**entirely based on performance**
.
  
  
**Candidates Who Consistently Demonstrate**

* Learning capability
* Professional conduct
* Improvement mindset
* Discipline
* Accountability
* Positive attitude
* Technical and practical improvement
* Consistency
* Commitment to excellence

will continue through the internship program.
  
  
Candidates who fail to meet the expected standards at any stage may be discontinued from the internship without progressing to the next block.
  
  
**Completion of a particular number of days does not automatically qualify a candidate for the next block. Successful assessment is mandatory for progression.**
Employment Opportunity
  
  
Candidates who successfully complete
**all six internship blocks (150 working days)**
with
**strong, consistent, and proven performance**
will be considered for a
**Fresher employment opportunity**
with the organization.
  
  
**Candidates Who Demonstrate**

* Strong learning capability
* Consistent performance
* Better assessment ratings
* Technical and practical competency
* Professional discipline
* Ownership and accountability
* Positive attitude
* Adaptability
* Ability to contribute effectively to the organization

may offered a
**Fresher role with a starting CTC of ₹1.8 LPA**
, subject to the organization's final assessment, available positions, and business requirements.
  
  
The employment opportunity is intended for candidates who successfully demonstrate strong performance and achieve the required assessment standards throughout the complete internship program.
  
  
Terms & Conditions
  
  
By applying for this internship, candidates acknowledge and agree to the following:
  
  

* Successful completion of the 5-working-day assessment is mandatory before joining the internship.
* The internship consists of six assessment blocks of 25 working days each, totaling 150 working days.
* The first three blocks, totaling 75 working days, are unpaid and no stipend will be provided during this period.
* Candidates must successfully clear the assessment of each block to continue to the subsequent block.
* Candidates who successfully progress to Blocks 4, 5, and 6 may be eligible for a stipend of ₹5,000 per block, subject to satisfactory performance and successful completion of the respective block.
* The maximum stipend payable during the final three blocks is ₹15,000.
* Stipend eligibility is performance-based and is not guaranteed merely by attendance or completion of the block.
* Candidates who fail to meet the required performance standards may be discontinued from the internship and will not be permitted to proceed to the next block.
* Candidates are expected to possess strong self-learning capability, discipline, professionalism, accountability, and a positive attitude towards continuous improvement.
* Candidates should remain fully focused on learning, performing, and building their careers throughout the internship.
* Any form of indiscipline, groupism, misconduct, unethical behaviour, misuse of company resources, or activities that negatively impact the learning environment will not be tolerated and may result in immediate discontinuation from the internship.
* Candidates are expected to maintain complete confidentiality regarding company information, projects, clients, intellectual property, and internal processes.
* Performance evaluations conducted by the organization shall be final and binding.
* Completion of the internship does not automatically guarantee employment.
* Candidates who successfully complete all six blocks with strong and consistently demonstrated performance may be considered for a Fresher position with a starting CTC of ₹1.8 LPA, subject to business requirements and available openings.
* Candidates who voluntarily discontinue the internship or whose internship is terminated due to unsatisfactory performance, misconduct, or violation of company policies will not be eligible to receive an Internship Completion Certificate or Experience Certificate for the period served.
* Candidates seeking only a certificate, immediate stipend, or immediate salary should not apply for this program.
* Certification is not guaranteed merely based on joining or attending the internship.
* All decisions made by the organization regarding assessment results, continuation, discontinuation, stipend eligibility, certification, and employment shall be final.

Ready to Build Your Career?
  
  
**If You Are**

* Self-motivated
* Disciplined
* Passionate about learning
* Interested in the ERP domain
* Willing to work hard
* Willing to learn through practical experience
* Ready to undergo strict performance assessments
* Looking for genuine industry exposure
* Committed to building a long-term career
* Interested in proving yourself through performance

we encourage you to apply and begin your professional journey with
**Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited**
.
  
  
**Learn. Perform. Improve. Prove Yourself. Build Your Career.**
**Apply Now and Shape Your Future with Us.**
Important Information
  
  
Limited Vacancies
  
  
**Please Note:**
Internship positions are limited. Applications will be processed on a
**first-come, first-preference basis**
, subject to eligibility and successful completion of the selection process.
  
  
We encourage interested candidates to apply as early as possible.
  
  
Assessment & Internship Details
  
  
**Location:**
Office-Based
**(On-Premises only)**

Chromepet, Chennai

Monday to Friday

**Attendance:**
Continuous participation throughout both the Assessment and Internship is mandatory.
  
  
This internship is a full-time, office-based learning program. Candidates should ensure they can commit to the complete schedule before applying.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
If You Are Genuinely Interested In This Opportunity, Please Submit Your Application Along With Your Updated Resume And Provide Detailed Responses To The Following Questions

Important Notice
