title: WFM (UKG Pro/ Kronos / Boomi) - Senior
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**EY- Global Delivery Services (GDS) – People Consulting (PC) - Work Force Management (WFM) – UKG WFM Boomi Senior**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for
**Senior Consultants**
with expertise in
**Boomi integration**
development within
**UKG Pro Workforce Management**
to join the GDS PC team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading global professional services organisation whilst being instrumental in the growth of the GDS PC team.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and support end‑to‑end UKG Pro WFM integrations using the Boomi AtomSphere platform.
* Work across the full integration lifecycle including Discovery, Design, Configuration, Build, Testing, Knowledge Transfer, Migration, and Post‑Production Support involving third‑party systems.
* Implement API‑led and event‑driven integration patterns for both inbound and outbound interfaces.
* Perform data mapping, validation, transformation, and error handling across integrated systems to ensure data accuracy and stability.
* Analyse Boomi Process/Atom logs to diagnose integration issues, monitor system behaviour, and optimize workflows for performance and reliability.
* Ensure high quality, accuracy, and timeliness of all integration deliverables and technical documentation.
* Drive effective client communication and delivery cadence, collaborating closely with client stakeholders and project team members across global locations.
* Work on client engagements as part of a global distributed delivery team, coordinating across time zones and functions.
* Consistently deliver high‑quality outcomes to achieve strong client satisfaction and positive feedback from global project counterparts.
* Contribute to the development of thought leadership, collateral, tools, techniques, and methodologies to strengthen Workforce Management service offerings.
* Support and participate in EY practice initiatives and internal capability‑building efforts.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Demonstrates strong analytical capability with a structured approach to problem‑solving.
* Ability to manage ambiguity, take ownership, and work proactively in dynamic environments.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage diverse stakeholders.
* Cross‑cultural awareness and sensitivity, comfortable working with global teams.
* High energy levels, agility, and adaptability in challenging delivery environments.
* High integrity and commitment to working in new and demanding environments.
* Open to national and international travel for client engagements, subject to EY and country‑specific travel advisory guidelines.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 6 - 9 years of relevant experience
* Minimum 4 years of experience in Workforce management (Time management, attendance, forecasting, scheduling, etc.) and Payroll consulting
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* Experience of working in a consulting environment on global client projects
* Boomi Professional Developer Certification/Badge
* Strong understanding of REST/SOAP APIs, web services, data mapping and ETL frameworks.
* Proficiency in Groovy/JavaScript within Boomi is highly desired.
* Well versed in API testing tools like PostMan

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Demonstrated technical proficiencies in UKG WFM; a practical/business driven approach to solving complex global Workforce Management client challenges
* Strong technical knowledge and experience of end-to-end Workforce Management process
* Analytical abilities and knowledge of Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Expertise in process mapping and documentation using Visio and other tools
* Expertise in creating SOP, process documentation and work instructions
* Ability to undertake Workforce Management process review and improvement activities including the identification of process efficiencies and control effectiveness.
* Exposure to work force transformation programs enabled by technology. Led or been part of a work stream in multi work stream transformation program
* Involved in policy review, current Workforce Management assessments, vendor selections, designing payroll processes and strategies at global level, global payroll implementation support

**What We Look For**

* Professionals who are independent, self-motivated, proactive, results-oriented and able to provide a high level of customer satisfaction through the delivery of world-class support services. Apart from day-to-day activities, the candidate is expected to be involved in strategic planning to grow the team.
* Technical experts with commercial acumen, relevant experiences and high degree of enthusiasm to adapt and learn in a fast-moving environment
* Professionals who are willing to work in an environment of continual professional development, drive to take on new responsibilities and projects and work experiences with clients across geographies

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Solution Engineer
description:
**Your role**
**What You'll Be Doing**
Solution Engineer
  
  
What We Need
  
  
Corpay is seeking a Solutions Engineer for our Cross-Border division, within the Corporate Payments line of business department, located in Chennai, India.
**Reports to:**
Payment Solutions Manager (Chennai)
  
  
**About Corpay Cross-Border**
Corpay Cross-Border helps businesses move money globally, manage currency risk, and streamline international payments. Our technology supports customers operating across markets, currencies, and regulatory environments, where reliability, security, and scale matter every day.
  
  
As part of Corpay, Inc. (NYSE: CPAY), a global corporate payments company, we combine the pace of a product-led technology team with the reach and stability of a global financial services business. To learn more, visit Payments.corpay.com/cross-border.
  
  
How We Work
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer at Corpay, Corpay will set you up for success by providing:
  
  

* Assigned workspace in our Chennai office
* Company-issued equipment
* Formal, hands-on training

Role Overview
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer at Corpay Cross-Border, you will support the technical onboarding and implementation of clients integrating with Corpay's digital payment and FX solutions.
  
  
The role will primarily support clients and internal stakeholders across North America, with working hours aligned to the US Eastern Time (ET) timezone, while also providing technical support to client implementations and initiatives across other global regions as required.
  
  
You will work closely with Technical Sales Consultants and other Payment Solutions teams to support clients across integration modalities including REST APIs, File Upload, SFTP, ERP and other digital payment capabilities. The role requires strong technical aptitude, analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
In addition to client implementations, Solutions Engineering is regularly relied upon to support special projects, new product initiatives and ad-hoc business requirements. The successful candidate should therefore be comfortable working across a variety of technical challenges and adapting to evolving business priorities.
  
  
The position will be primarily remote; however, the successful candidate will initially attend the Chennai office for induction and training and will be expected to attend occasionally thereafter for team meetings, training and other business requirements.
  
  
Role Responsibilities
  
  
**The Responsibilities Of The Role Will Include**
Client Implementation & Solutioning
  
  

* Support end-to-end technical implementation activities from onboarding through testing, certification and Production go-live.
* Support clients integrating through Corpay's REST APIs, File Upload, SFTP, ERP and other supported integration modalities.
* Participate in technical discovery and solutioning discussions to understand client requirements and determine appropriate implementation approaches.
* Support clients with test environment setup, configuration and integration readiness activities.
* Provide clear and timely responses to client and internal technical implementation questions.
* Support certification testing, Production readiness and post-go-live warranty activities to ensure successful client adoption.
* Take ownership of assigned implementation activities while escalating complex technical or delivery risks appropriately.
* Maintain accurate and timely implementation documentation and project updates.

Technical Analysis & Troubleshooting
  
  

* Investigate integration, configuration and implementation issues using appropriate diagnostic tools and available system information.
* Analyse API requests and responses, file structures, payment workflows, logs and other technical data to identify potential causes and solutions.
* Work collaboratively with Technical Sales, Product, Engineering, Client Engagement, Support and other teams to resolve technical blockers.
* Clearly document technical findings, troubleshooting steps and recommended solutions.
* Contribute to testing and validation of new or enhanced product capabilities where Solutions Engineering support is required.

Global Team & Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Work closely with Technical Sales Consultants and the Solutions Engineering Lead to support successful client delivery across North America and, where required, other global regions.
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues across different geographies and time zones.
* Share lessons learned, technical knowledge and implementation best practices with the wider Solutions Engineering team.
* Contribute to team documentation, implementation standards and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
* Maintain effective communication with North American stakeholders while remaining connected to the wider Chennai and global Payment Solutions organisation.

Special Projects, Automation & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Support special and ad-hoc business initiatives requiring technical analysis, implementation support, testing, reporting or other Solutions Engineering expertise.
* Support Product and other stakeholders with the testing, analysis and rollout of new technical capabilities where appropriate.
* Identify opportunities to improve implementation and business processes through automation and improved tooling.
* Develop, maintain or enhance automated workflows using tools such as Microsoft Power Automate where appropriate.
* Work with stakeholders to understand automation requirements and translate them into practical and supportable solutions.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency, scalability and delivery quality.
* Contribute to the continued standardisation and improvement of Solutions Engineering processes, documentation and implementation approaches.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 3–5 years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Technical Sales, implementation consulting, technical support, or a comparable client-facing technical role, ideally within payments, fintech or financial services.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership of client-facing technical issues and implementations, and exercise sound judgement when determining when escalation is required.
* Hands-on experience with REST APIs, file-based integrations, SFTP and/or ERP solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience using tools such as Postman, SQL, Kibana, SEQ, Jira, Confluence or equivalent would be advantageous.
* Experience within payments, fintech, banking or financial services would be advantageous.
* Experience supporting North American clients or working across US time zones would be beneficial.
* Exposure to workflow automation tools such as Microsoft Power Automate or equivalent would be advantageous.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities effectively while maintaining ownership of assigned deliverables.
* Ability to adapt to ad-hoc projects, new technical requirements and changing business priorities.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting production-grade software products and shared platform capabilities within DNV’s Digital & Transformation organization. This role sits within the Application Engineering section and contributes to the development and modernization of scalable web applications that support digital delivery across Energy Systems.
  
  
This role helps to advance how DNV performs Due Diligence, Verification & Assurance, and Renewables Certification work across Energy Systems.
  
  
This is not a project-based delivery or staff-augmentation role. Engineers are expected to develop deep product knowledge and remain accountable for the quality, maintainability, and operation of the software they build.
  
  
Working in close partnership with Frontend Engineers, Product leadership, Data & AI Engineering, Solution Engineering, Platform Reliability, Solution Architecture, and Platform Security & Compliance, this role helps bring application capabilities, data services, AI-enabled features, workflows, and APIs into one cohesive platform and product experience.
  
  
The Senior Software Engineer designs, builds, tests, deploys, and supports scalable software across a modern Microsoft-oriented full-stack environment. The primary stack includes C# and .NET 10, Entity Framework Core, SignalR, MySQL, Redis, TypeScript, React, Redux, Tailwind CSS, Docker, .NET Aspire, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, and Azure DevOps. The role requires strong engineering fundamentals, practical cloud experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively across globally distributed teams.
  
  
This role supports custom software development, application modernization, and integration with low-code or hybrid development environments, helping establish shared patterns, APIs, reusable components, and maintainable application architecture across the platform.

* NET Application Development

* Develop solutions for Azure and contribute to their deployment and support.

* Develop application capabilities used for structured review workflows, real-time collaboration, issue tracking, customer interaction, reporting, and delivery of technical work products.
* Partner with Product and design stakeholders to ensure application functionality is intuitive, reliable, and aligned with user workflows.
* Develop APIs, backend services, frontend components, and integration patterns that support platform interoperability.
* Help integrate applications with data services, AI-enabled capabilities, workflow configurations, authentication patterns, and enterprise systems.
* Contribute to reusable development patterns, documentation, and engineering practices that improve team velocity and consistency.
* Integrate data-driven, search, agentic, and AI-enabled capabilities into production web applications using well-defined APIs and reusable application patterns.

**Modern Development & AI-Enabled Engineering**

* Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, documentation, refactoring, and engineering analysis.
* Apply strong engineering judgment when using LLM-enabled workflows, ensuring generated or assisted code meets standards for quality, security, maintainability, and performance.
* Use AI-enabled tools where appropriate to support test generation, code review preparation, technical documentation, and developer productivity.

**DevOps, Reliability & Security**

* Contribute to Azure DevOps repositories and pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation, environment management, monitoring, and incident readiness.
* Build software using an Agile methodology, with strong attention to reliability, performance, availability, scalability, and operational support.
* Support observability practices including logging, monitoring, error handling, and production diagnostics.
* Follow secure development practices aligned with internal security standards, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and enterprise security expectations.
* Collaborate with Platform Reliability, Security, and Global Shared Services teams to support secure, reliable, and maintainable production systems.

**Collaboration & Technical Ownership**

* Work effectively with Product, Solution Engineering, Data & AI Engineering, Platform Reliability, Architecture, Security, and regional teams in a globally distributed environment.
* Take ownership of assigned features, services, defects, and technical improvements from design through production support.
* Communicate technical trade-offs clearly and contribute to pragmatic engineering decisions.

title: Associate Senior Solutions Architect - req38675
description:
**Associate Senior Solutions Architect**
Job #: req38675
  
  
Organization: World Bank
  
  
Sector: Information Technology
  
  
Grade: GG
  
  
Term Duration: Open-Ended Staff (OPEN-OP)
  
  
Recruitment Type: Local Recruitment
  
  
Location: Chennai,India
  
  
Required Language(s): English
  
  
**Preferred Language(s)**
Closing Date: 10/30/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC
  
  
**Description**
At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd
  
  
**ITS Vice Presidency Context**
The Information and Technology Solutions (ITS) Vice Presidential Unit (VPU) enables the World Bank Group to achieve its mission of ending extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by delivering transformative information and technologies to its staff working in over 150+ locations. For more information on ITS, see this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?reload=9&v=VTFGffa1Y7w
  
  
**Department Context**
The ITS Operations Products unit (ITSOP) enables the Bank's operational business processes through modern, flexible and user-friendly digital products. Its portfolio includes Operations Workspace and related solutions that bring together operational data, documents, workflows, collaboration and decision support for front-line staff.
  
  
ITSOP is seeking an Associate Senior Solutions Architect to provide hands-on architecture and engineering leadership for the Operations Workspace ecosystem. The successful candidate will combine deep Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse expertise with strong .NET and Azure engineering skills, personally implement prototypes and reference solutions, and guide delivery teams from design through production. The role will also help integrate Generative AI and agentic capabilities into operational workflows using a governed AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC). This is not a purely advisory role.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect translates complex operational requirements into secure, scalable and maintainable solutions across Dynamics 365, Dataverse, .NET, Azure, APIs, data platforms and AI services. The role defines architecture, validates choices through working code, establishes reusable patterns and guardrails, and remains directly engaged in troubleshooting, CI/CD, release readiness and production improvement.
  
  
**Duties And Accountabilities**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect works across multiple projects in the World Bank Operations portfolio and is accountable for ensuring that technical solutions are successfully designed, delivered and operated for Operations staff.
  
  
From a work-program perspective, the role provides technical leadership, delivery oversight and practical guidance to internal staff and globally distributed vendor teams. The architect helps sequence technical work, resolves delivery constraints and ensures that implementation remains aligned with business priorities, enterprise standards and release commitments.
  
  
From a technical perspective, the role leads application, integration and data architecture; identifies solution components and reusable patterns; validates designs through working prototypes; performs quality and code reviews; and remains accountable for delivery at speed, scale and quality.
  
  
**Role Scope and Distinction**

* Acts as a senior technical subject matter expert for complex, business-critical solutions in the Operations Workspace portfolio.
* Balances strategic architecture with recent, demonstrable hands-on contribution to prototypes, code, integration, deployment and technical problem-solving.
* Leads cross-layer design decisions involving applications, workflows, data, APIs, identity, security, observability and AI-enabled experiences.
* Guides multidisciplinary teams and vendors, mentors architects and engineers, and raises engineering quality through practical standards and reusable implementation assets.
* Works across globally distributed business, product, architecture, security, data, platform and engineering stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership**

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture for Operations Workspace and related products, aligning business outcomes, enterprise principles, security requirements and delivery constraints.
* Define target-state and transition architectures, solution options, architecture decision records, integration contracts, non-functional requirements and implementation roadmaps.
* Review designs and code for scalability, resilience, maintainability, interoperability, usability, performance and cost effectiveness.
* Identify systemic risks and technical debt, propose pragmatic remediation, and guide Agile Release Train and product teams through implementation trade-offs.

Lead solution delivery teams through implementation, maintenance, release readiness and operational improvement of business-critical applications supporting Operations Workspace and related Operations product ecosystems.
  
  
Lead application and data architecture modelling, component identification and solution quality reviews, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles and approved technology standards.
  
  
**Dynamics 365 and Dataverse Engineering**

* Architect and implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse solutions, including data models, security roles, business rules, workflows, plug-ins, custom actions, Power Platform components and environment strategy.
* Design supported extension patterns using C#/.NET, the Dataverse SDK and APIs while minimizing fragile customization and preserving upgradeability.
* Guide integration of Dynamics 365 with SharePoint Online, Microsoft Graph, Azure services, enterprise data products and other operational systems.
* Define application lifecycle management practices for solutions, configuration, environment variables, connection references, test data and controlled promotion across environments.

**Hands-on Prototyping and .NET Engineering**

* Personally design, code, test and demonstrate proofs of concept, technical spikes, reference implementations and minimum viable solutions.
* Develop secure APIs, services, plug-ins and integration components using C#, modern .NET, ASP.NET Core and RESTful patterns.
* Validate architecture choices through executable prototypes, performance tests and failure-mode testing before major delivery investment.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across user experience, application, integration, identity, data and infrastructure layers, and support teams during critical releases.

**Integration, Cloud and Platform Architecture**

* Design API-led, event-driven and workflow-based integrations using appropriate Azure services, API management, messaging, serverless and container patterns.
* Apply identity-first design using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, least privilege, secrets management and auditable authorization patterns, including B2E and approved external-access scenarios.
* Define observability using structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, dashboards and actionable alerts across application and integration components.
* Collaborate with data and platform teams to connect operational applications to governed data services, analytics products and structured and unstructured enterprise information.

Design integrations with institutional systems and data platforms, including financing, trust funds, board operations, budgeting, SAP and enterprise data services, using supported APIs, events and workflow patterns.
  
  
Architect document and content-management integrations across Dynamics 365, SharePoint Online and approved cloud services, including secure storage, metadata, retrieval and downstream AI processing.
  
  
**Agentic AI and AI-enabled Operations**

* Design and prototype AI-enabled features and agentic workflows embedded in Operations Workspace, with explicit task boundaries, approved tools, controlled permissions, human review and failure handling.
* Integrate agents with Dynamics 365, enterprise APIs, documents, data platforms and business workflows using secure tool calling, structured outputs and reusable orchestration patterns.
* Apply retrieval-augmented generation, document intelligence and knowledge-grounding approaches where they improve operational workflows and decision support.
* Define evaluation, telemetry and guardrails for groundedness, task success, safety, latency, reliability and cost, and ensure Responsible AI, privacy, records and security requirements are addressed.

Partner with information security teams on architecture reviews, threat modelling, control implementation, security testing and remediation evidence required for production approval.
  
  
**Delivery Lifecycle, CI/CD and Engineering Excellence**

* Establish and improve CI/CD pipelines for Dynamics 365 solutions, .NET services, infrastructure configuration and AI components using Azure DevOps or equivalent enterprise tooling.
* Embed automated unit, integration, contract, security, regression and performance testing into delivery pipelines, with quality gates, approvals, release evidence and rollback approaches.
* Apply both the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and a governed AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC), covering use-case framing, data and grounding readiness, prompt and tool versioning, evaluation, deployment, monitoring and change control.
* Create reusable templates, starter repositories, SDKs, reference pipelines, coding standards and implementation guidance that improve developer productivity and consistency.

**Stakeholder, Vendor and Team Leadership**

* Translate operational needs into feasible technical choices and communicate architecture decisions and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Provide practical technical direction to internal teams and vendors, review deliverables against agreed architecture and quality expectations, and intervene hands-on where necessary.
* Mentor architects and engineers through pairing, design reviews, code reviews, demonstrations and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Partner with product leadership to sequence enablers, reduce delivery risk and ensure technical work results in measurable operational value.

Provide work-program oversight for internal and vendor delivery teams across locations, assess deliverable quality, remove technical blockers and hold suppliers accountable for agreed architecture, engineering and documentation standards.
  
  
Selection Criteria
  
  

* Master's degree with at least eight years of relevant experience, or bachelor's degree with at least ten years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, in computer science, software engineering, information systems or a related field.
* Substantial recent experience architecting and delivering large-scale enterprise applications using Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dataverse, .NET and Azure.
* Demonstrated hands-on contribution to production solutions, including personal coding, prototyping, integration, troubleshooting and deployment responsibilities.
* Experience leading complex delivery across internal staff, vendors and globally distributed teams in environments with strong governance, security and operational requirements.
* At least seven years of experience developing and maintaining large-scale solutions using C# and the Microsoft .NET ecosystem.
* At least five years of experience architecting Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Dataverse solutions and integrations with SharePoint Online, Azure services and enterprise or on-premises systems.
* Proven experience leading large, complex technical deliverables and globally distributed development teams, including vendor or offshore delivery, in environments with shifting priorities and multi-layered governance.

**Required Technical Capabilities**

* Advanced Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse architecture, including data modelling, security, workflows, plug-ins, custom APIs, Power Platform extensibility and solution ALM.
* Advanced C# and modern .NET engineering, including ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, dependency injection, asynchronous programming, automated testing and secure coding.
* Strong Azure application architecture experience, including App Service, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, Application Insights, storage and container-based deployment patterns.
* Strong systems integration capability across APIs, events, enterprise applications, Microsoft 365 services, SharePoint Online and data platforms.
* Hands-on CI/CD and DevSecOps experience, including source control, branching, build and release pipelines, infrastructure/configuration automation, quality gates, secrets handling and rollback.
* Practical experience designing or implementing Generative AI and agentic capabilities, including tool calling, orchestration, retrieval, structured outputs, evaluation, observability and human oversight.
* Ability to apply SDLC and ADLC controls to move prototypes into secure, supportable and production-ready services.
* Strong security architecture knowledge covering identity, authorization, least privilege, data protection, auditability, threat modelling and secure integration.
* Ability to produce clear architecture documentation and to explain decisions, alternatives, risks and trade-offs to varied audiences.
* Hands-on experience extending Dynamics 365 using C#/.NET plug-ins, custom APIs, workflows and supported client-side technologies, with strong knowledge of Dataverse security, data modelling and reporting capabilities.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID, including B2E and approved B2B scenarios.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Operations Workspace, operational process platforms, project or portfolio management solutions, or comparable enterprise CRM/workflow ecosystems.
* Experience with Angular or React and modern web application integration with .NET and Dynamics 365 back ends.
* Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel or comparable enterprise agent frameworks.
* Experience with document intelligence, enterprise search, RAG, semantic layers, knowledge graphs or governed access to structured and unstructured information.
* Experience with SAFe, Agile Release Trains, product operating models and architecture governance.
* Experience in international development, financial services or another regulated environment with strong privacy, security and audit requirements.
* Relevant Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, DevOps, security or architecture certifications.
* Working knowledge of enterprise data and analytics platforms, including data lakes, data warehouses, Power BI, Azure Data Factory, Databricks or comparable integration and analytics services.

**Recommended Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert or relevant Dynamics 365 certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert.
* SAFe for Architects (ARCH) and/or SAFe DevOps (SDP).
* Relevant Microsoft applied skills or certifications in Azure AI, Azure OpenAI or Copilot Studio.

As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:
  
  

* Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
* Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.
* Bring experience working in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent (FCV) contexts and are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in their application materials, where applicable.

**WBG Culture Attributes**

* Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.
* Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
* Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.

World Bank Group Core Competencies
  
  
The World Bank Group offers comprehensive benefits, including a retirement plan; medical, life and disability insurance; and paid leave, including parental leave, as well as reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities.
  
  
We are proud to be an equal opportunity and inclusive employer with a dedicated and committed workforce, and do not discriminate based on gender, gender identity, religion, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disability.

title: Technical Lead, Software Development
description:

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
  
  
**Group/Division**
With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The Optical Metrology Division products are used for optical overlay metrology. The portfolio of products includes unique solution packages which are based on hardware and software systems to enhance yield and effectiveness. As a world leader in its field of expertise, the division's products are the most advanced in performance (measurement accuracy of nanometers and below), reliability, ease of use and compatibility with other KLA's products. KLA (Israel) controls over 80% of the world market sales in its field, and its products are used by every major semiconductor manufacturer around the world. KLA Israel is located in the Migdal Haemek Industrial Park.

What if every customer around the world could pay for their order in the way that feels most natural to them? The Digital and Emerging Payments team at Amazon is working to make that happen, building payment experiences that work across geographies, platforms, and customer expectations. From Android and Fire devices to resilient back-end systems that guarantee no order is ever lost, the technical challenges here are real and the customer impact is global.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to help lead the technical direction of our payments platform. You will own the design and delivery of systems that process transactions at massive scale, mentor fellow engineers, and shape architectural decisions that determine how millions of customers complete their purchases. If you’re passionate about solving complex distributed systems challenges and want to make a direct impact on the customer experience, this could be the role for you.

The Digital and Emerging Payments team is responsible for how Amazon customers pay across the globe. We build and run the systems that connect customers to the payment methods they trust, whether that is a credit card, a mobile wallet, or a region-specific option unique to their market. Our mission is to make every transaction feel simple and reliable.
  
  
We are an inclusive group that values knowledge sharing and mentorship. title: Senior Staff Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
  
  
Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
****cut carbon****
.
  
  
**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**

* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all.
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.

Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
* Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits


+ Flexible Leave Policy
+ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose

* We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.
* Medical Insurance (1+5 Family Members)
* Flexible Benefit Plan
* Awards and Bonus
* Annual performance cycle
* Quarterly engagement activities
* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency

**What We’re Looking For**
We are seeking a
****Senior Staff Engineer (L6)****
to join Core Engineering in India as a senior individual contributor operating across squads rather than inside one. You will be the technical subject matter expert our teams pull in when the problem is hard, the design is ambiguous, or the blast radius is large — moving between our Acquisition, Extraction and Storage, and Presentment squads as priorities shift.
  
  
This role exists because our squads are shipping faster than our design review capacity. We have driven deep adoption of AI-assisted development across India engineering, and the constraint has moved: teams can now produce architecture and implementations quickly, but senior validation of those designs concentrates on too few people. You will be one of a small number of engineers trusted to review and approve significant designs, and to raise the design ceiling of the engineers around you.
  
  
You will not have direct reports. Your influence comes from technical depth, design judgment, and mentorship rather than reporting lines. This is a hybrid, remote-first role anchored in Chennai, working daily with US-based engineering and product partners.
  
  
Our engineering values are deeply ingrained in our culture — you can read more about them here.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Act as the floating technical SME across Core Engineering squads, embedding where the hardest current problem is and moving on once the team is self-sufficient
* Review and approve component and service designs, sharing design authority with squad leads so that architecture approval stops being a single-person bottleneck
* Own the design of complex, cross-service changes spanning multiple owners — provider data model changes, extraction pipeline evolution, migrations, and event contract changes
* Write production code on the critical path. This is a hands-on role; you will be in the repositories, not only in documents
* Set and raise the bar on non-functional requirements: performance, scalability, reliability, observability, and cost across the services you touch
* Validate AI-generated designs and implementations, reviewing agent output for architectural soundness, hidden coupling, and failure modes the model did not consider
* Advance how we do AI-assisted engineering: spec-driven development, reusable skills and subagents, prompt patterns that hold up against our codebase, and automation of recurring work
* Mentor Staff Engineers and below through pairing, design review, and constructive feedback, measurably lifting the technical judgment of the squads you rotate through
* Lead major refactoring and technical debt reduction across legacy platform services, sequencing the work so that delivery continues
* Debug and resolve complex production issues that cross service, data, and infrastructure boundaries
* Write the design documents, architecture decision records, and runbooks that make your decisions durable. Confluence is our single source of truth
* Partner with US engineering leads on cross-region initiatives, representing India engineering in architecture discussions

**What Will Help You Succeed**
The following list reflects our current technology stack. You will need meaningful overlap or analogous experience, but not an exact match.
  
  
****Must-haves****

* 10–12+ years in software engineering, with a track record of owning technically complex, multi-service work end to end
* Deep production expertise in Python, plus working fluency in a second ecosystem such as Java and Spring Boot or TypeScript/Node
* Strong distributed systems and event-driven architecture experience — queues, streams, idempotency, eventual consistency, and backpressure
* Hands-on AWS (ECS/EKS, S3, Lambda, Kinesis or equivalent) and containerized deployment on Kubernetes
* Solid relational data modeling and query tuning (MySQL, Postgres), plus search or analytical stores (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, Snowflake)
* Demonstrated ability to review other people’s designs and improve them. You can point to architectures that are better because you were in the room
* Practical, daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor, and of spec-driven development, with a clear view of where they help and where they mislead
* Credibility without authority: able to influence squads you are not part of, and to mentor senior engineers without managing them
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and comfort operating across India and US time zones
* Comfort with ambiguity and rotation — the willingness to be reassigned to the highest-value problem rather than owning one fixed surface

****Nice to have****

* Utility, energy, or fintech data domain experience
* Web data acquisition at scale (Puppeteer, headless Chrome, anti-bot mitigation)
* Document extraction, OCR, or LLM-based extraction pipelines
* dbt and analytics engineering on Snowflake
* Experience modernizing legacy monoliths into services while keeping delivery running

****Eliminating carbon footprints, eliminating carbon copies.****
Here at Arcadia, we cultivate diversity, celebrate individuality, and believe unique perspectives are key to our collective success in creating a clean energy future. Arcadia is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. While we are currently unable to consider candidates who will require visa sponsorship, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates eligible to work in India.

title: Technical Lead – Java, Spring Boot & GCP
description:
As a Technical Lead / Tech Anchor within Ford Credit IT, you will be part of a balanced product team responsible for building and evolving digital products and services. You will work closely with Software Engineers, Product Managers, Product Owners, Designers, Architects, and Engineering Managers supporting Contact Center and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) applications.
  
  
You will provide technical leadership across the software delivery lifecycle, from discovery and architecture through development, testing, deployment, observability, and production support. You will promote modern engineering practices including Extreme Programming (XP), pair programming, Test-Driven Development (TDD), Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD), DevSecOps, and automated testing.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong hands-on Java engineering capabilities with cloud architecture expertise and the ability to guide teams through complex technical decisions.
  
  

* Define and evolve the technical roadmap and architecture for scalable, highly available digital platforms.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy applications using Java 17+, Spring Boot 3.x, Spring Framework, and microservices architectures.
* Design cloud-native solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) using services such as Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, and Memorystore/Redis.
* Design resilient distributed systems incorporating appropriate scalability, availability, fault-tolerance, and disaster-recovery patterns.
* Build and maintain RESTful APIs and create API documentation using OpenAPI/Swagger or equivalent standards.
* Design API integration solutions using Apigee and Java/Spring Boot.
* Implement appropriate caching strategies, including reverse-proxy/endpoint caching, cache-aside, read-through, and write-through patterns.
* Conduct technical discovery to identify business requirements, technical constraints, current-state challenges, and target-state solutions.
* Evaluate solution alternatives against architecture, security, performance, reliability, maintainability, and cost requirements.
* Partner with enterprise and solution architects and follow established architecture governance processes.
* Contribute hands-on production-quality code and conduct code and architecture reviews.
* Establish and promote engineering quality practices using tools such as SonarQube, Cycode, and 42Crunch, where applicable.
* Develop automated unit, integration, contract, and performance tests.
* Apply TDD practices using technologies such as JUnit and Mockito and conduct performance testing using tools such as JMeter.
* Build and maintain CI/CD processes using technologies such as Google Cloud Build, Tekton, and Terraform.
* Integrate security practices, including Static Application Security Testing (SAST) and Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), into the software delivery lifecycle.
* Establish application observability through monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, and automated failure notifications using platforms such as Splunk and Dynatrace.
* Participate in and promote collaborative engineering practices including XP, pair programming, code reviews, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate in Agile activities including stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews/demos, retrospectives, and journey mapping.
* Analyze user stories, identify technical dependencies and risks, and support effective engineering estimation and planning.
* Mentor engineers, improve engineering standards, and foster knowledge sharing across teams.
* Research emerging technologies and conduct proofs of concept (PoCs) where they can improve platform capability, developer productivity, resilience, or customer outcomes.
* Collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams and stakeholders supporting North American markets.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering/Technology, MCA, or equivalent relevant education and professional experience.
* 6+ years of experience designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise web applications and backend services.
* Strong hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot, including modern Java development practices.
* Experience designing and developing microservices and RESTful APIs.
* Experience designing scalable, resilient, and highly available distributed systems.
* 3+ years of experience with public cloud platforms, with strong practical experience in GCP preferred.
* Practical knowledge of GCP services such as Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, and Redis/Memorystore, or equivalent services on other major cloud platforms.
* Experience with automated testing using tools/frameworks such as JUnit and Mockito.
* Experience implementing automated CI/CD pipelines.
* Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.
* Understanding of API management concepts and platforms such as Apigee.
* Understanding of application security, secure coding, and automated security testing practices.
* Experience implementing monitoring, logging, tracing, and production observability.
* Strong understanding of software engineering practices including clean code, code reviews, automated testing, TDD, and continuous integration.
* Ability to provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and communicate complex technical decisions to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

**Preferred**

* Deep hands-on experience architecting solutions on GCP.
* Experience with reactive programming and event-driven architecture.
* Experience with asynchronous messaging and streaming/data pipeline patterns.
* Experience implementing multiple distributed caching strategies.
* Experience with Apigee API management.
* Experience with SonarQube, Cycode, 42Crunch, Splunk, and/or Dynatrace.
* Experience with Tekton and Google Cloud Build.
* Experience working in an Extreme Programming (XP) environment, including pair programming and TDD.
* Experience supporting large-scale customer-facing or Contact Center/CRM platforms.

title: Specialist, Software Technology
description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. First to deliver the best imaging and classification data for every defect or point on any layer at any time. EBeam’s mission encapsulates its role as the “eyes” of KLA’s product line, providing timely information on defects and critical locations on the wafer at the highest spatial resolution possible. Customers use EBeam products alongside KLA patterned and bare wafer inspectors to quickly understand the nature of defects and other imperfections on product wafers and take action to correct the manufacturing process.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
**Must have Qualifications:**
* Deep proficiency in core programming concepts, with hands\-on expertise in Java, Python, or C\+\+
* Strong background in object\-oriented design (OOD) and multi\-threaded application development
* Demonstrated experience in full\-stack web development, specializing in microservices architecture, performance optimization, and security best practices

title: Lead Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Arcadia is the AI\-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
   

  

 Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI\-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
 ****cut carbon****
 .
   

  

**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**
* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI\-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all.
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.


 Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
* Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits
* 
+ Flexible Leave Policy
+ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose

* We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.
* Medical Insurance (1\+5 Family Members)
* Flexible Benefit Plan
* Awards and Bonus
* Annual performance cycle
* Quarterly engagement activities
* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency


**What We're Looking For**
 We are seeking a Lead Engineer to be the technical anchor of our Growth \& Governance (GnG) squad in India — the team that acquires utility data from thousands of unreliable third\-party sources, extracts and audits it, and turns it into the trusted dataset the rest of the Arcadia platform is built on. Formats change without notice, sources fail silently, and correctness is visible to customers, so our core expertise is building systems that stay accurate against data that refuses to cooperate.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role with real ownership. You will own architecture for one or more of our services, lead projects end to end, act as a second point of technical review alongside the Engineering Manager, and mentor a team of earlier\-career engineers.
   

  

 AI has moved where the hard part of engineering sits. Producing code is no longer the bottleneck; deciding whether the produced code is the
 **right**
 answer is. We are looking for someone already well ahead on AI\-driven development who also has the architectural judgment to reject its confident wrong answers — and to teach a team of earlier\-career engineers to do the same rather than defer to the model.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the architecture and technical direction of one or more services in our acquisition, extraction, and audit pipeline, and lead medium\-to\-large projects on them end to end
* Translate ambiguous problems into engineering\-ready designs, and decompose large efforts into pieces the team can build in parallel
* Act as a primary design and code reviewer — the second layer of judgment on AI\-assisted designs and pull requests, catching architectural drift and silent correctness defects early
* Set the bar for AI\-driven development on the squad — and bring your own view of what that should look like
* Own a category of reliability and technical\-debt work end to end, without derailing roadmap commitments
* Share in the squad's production support rotation for the services you own, and improve what pages us
* Mentor earlier\-career engineers: raise their design instincts, review quality, and independence
* Partner with Product, Operations, our Data Analytics Engineering team, and US\-based engineering counterparts to shape requirements and drive cross\-team initiatives


**What Will Help You Succeed**
****Must\-Haves****
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8\+ years of software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, the majority building and operating backend or distributed systems in production
* A clear track record of owning projects end to end — from design through production — not just delivering assigned components
* Currently hands\-on. You have shipped production code within the last two years
* Experience with enterprise Java (Spring / Spring Boot preferred) and Python
* SQL and relational data modelling at depth — you have designed schemas that survived real growth, and debugged correctness problems in the data rather than only in the code
* Experience building and operating high\-volume data pipelines and third\-party integrations, where correctness matters as much as throughput
* Experience with event\-driven and asynchronous systems (streaming or queueing — Kinesis, Kafka, SQS or similar), including what goes wrong under retries and at\-least\-once delivery
* Deployed and operated systems on AWS or similar, on containerised platforms (Kubernetes / ECS)
* Production operability. You have owned services you were paged for — metrics and dashboards (Prometheus / Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog or similar), structured logging, tracing, and alerts that fire on customer\-visible symptoms rather than on every anomaly
* Strong AI\-driven development practice. You work daily in agentic coding tools and are fluent at managing context and steering them across a large, unfamiliar codebase. AI is central to how this squad works, so you should already be ahead on it — with your own view of what good looks like and the judgment to know when the output isn't
* Architectural judgment. You can articulate the tradeoffs behind a design, choose the simpler option when it holds, and explain why you rejected the alternatives — including when the alternative came from a tool or from a more senior voice in the room
* Technical rigor. Testing strategy across the pyramid, observability and alerting built in rather than bolted on, security and maintainability treated as requirements
* Demonstrated mentorship. You've been the person a team goes to, and you've levelled others up
* Clear written and verbal communication. You write designs people can act on, and you work well with a distributed team across time zones
* Flexibility to join evening meetings up to \~8:30 PM IST to collaborate with US\-based counterparts


****Nice\-to\-Haves****
* Experience shipping AI/LLM\-backed features to production — latency, accuracy, cost, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop design
* Experience building SQL data pipelines (Snowflake \+ dbt preferred)
* Experience in the energy industry, or another domain requiring deep knowledge of messy, unreliable source data

title: Backend Engineer (Go) – AI Security Platform
description:
**Location:** 
 India, Remote\-First
   

  

**Employment:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Start Date:** 
 November 2026 onward, with staggered start dates
   

  

**Experience:** 
 Mid\-Level to Senior
   

  

**Language:** 
 Fluent English required
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Cybersecurity / Enterprise SaaS / AI Security
   

  

**About The Opportunity**
 Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of a global enterprise cybersecurity company building a new generation of products to secure
 **AI agents, LLM\-powered applications, and the data they access** 
 .
   

  

 The engineering organization is scaling rapidly in India, with multiple Backend Engineer openings across several product workstreams.
   

  

 Depending on your experience and interests, you may join one of the following areas:
   

  

* Agentic Security: Real\-time policy enforcement for AI agent actions, tool calls, and data access.
* AI Security Gateway: High\-performance proxy between enterprise applications and LLM providers, covering inline inspection, DLP, rate limiting, and streaming.
* Platform: Shared multi\-tenant foundations including identity/RBAC, configuration, event streaming, storage, and internal APIs.
* Data Security Integration: Event\-driven integrations between AI security products and existing data security infrastructure.
* Cloud Discovery: Services that discover AI agents, model endpoints, and AI\-enabled applications across AWS, Azure, and GCP, and map their access.
* Agentic AI Forensics: Ingestion, indexing, and querying of agent traces and security events for investigation and analysis.
* AI Risk Research: Tooling and testing harnesses that enable security researchers to identify and validate attacks against AI agents.


 Across all workstreams, the core stack includes
 **Go, Python, gRPC/REST, event streaming, Kubernetes, and major cloud platforms** 
 . AI\-assisted development is also a core part of the engineering workflow.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Design, build, and operate production Go services with high standards for performance, reliability, and multi\-tenancy.
* Design APIs and data models, owning service contracts, idempotency, retries, and back\-pressure.
* Build event\-driven pipelines and integrations with cloud providers, internal systems, or AI/agent frameworks.
* Own service reliability through testing, observability, CI/CD, and production readiness.
* Use Python for tooling, testing, migrations, automation, or data workflows.
* Collaborate with AI engineers, security researchers, and product teams on threat models and enforcement logic.
* Use AI coding assistants as part of your daily development, testing, and debugging workflow.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 4\+ years of professional backend engineering experience, including 2\+ years building production services in Go. Senior roles require 6\+ years overall and 3\+ years in Go.
* Strong understanding of Go concurrency, networking, and performance, including goroutines, channels, context, and profiling.
* Working knowledge of Python.
* Experience designing gRPC and REST APIs, working with protobuf, and building asynchronous/event\-driven systems such as Kafka or equivalent.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider: AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases in distributed systems.
* Strong testing discipline and attention to data correctness.
* Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable using modern AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or similar. This is a must\-have.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership in a remote\-first, distributed environment.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience with API gateways, proxies, policy/authorization engines such as OPA or Cedar, or service meshes.
* Deep knowledge of a major cloud provider's APIs and IAM model.
* Experience with Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, ClickHouse, or other search/indexing and columnar data systems at scale.
* Familiarity with LLM agent frameworks, tool\-calling protocols, and AI/agent security.
* Experience building multi\-tenant SaaS platforms.
* Background in cybersecurity, security tooling, or trust \& safety.
* Experience introducing AI\-assisted or agentic development workflows across engineering teams.


 AI\-First Engineering
   

  

 AI is a core part of how this team builds software.
   

  

 During the interview process, you'll be asked about how you use AI in real\-world engineering: the tools you rely on, how you validate their output, and how AI has changed your development workflow.
   

  

 We're looking for engineers who use AI as a
 **force multiplier for quality, productivity, and problem\-solving** 
 , not simply as an autocomplete tool.
   

  

 Why Join
   

  

* Build a greenfield product at the intersection of cybersecurity and agentic AI.
* Work on Go services operating at enterprise scale and protecting some of the world's largest organizations.
* Take ownership of a product workstream and influence architecture from an early stage.
* Work alongside a highly technical, distributed engineering team where AI is a core part of the development process.


 Pragmatike is committed to a fair, transparent, and inclusive recruitment process. We do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.
   

  

 In accordance with GDPR, your personal data will be processed lawfully, fairly, and securely and used solely for recruitment purposes, including sharing it with our client(s) for employment consideration.

**Job Summary**
 A Senior Data Platform Engineer with 12\-14 years of experience to own and build the core data platform for a multi\-region CPaaS system supporting multiple digital channels.
   

  

 The platform processes 40,000\+ transactions per second, with multiple ( 10\) state updates per transaction, and powers real\-time metrics, billing, reporting, campaign analytics, and audits.

 Own the end\-to\-end data architecture for high\-throughput, event\-driven CPaaS systems.
   

  

 Design state\-transition and event\-sourced data models handling millions of updates per second.

 Design and maintain a data lake using Apache Hudi to support: Upserts and deletes
   

  

 Incremental queries
   

  

 Time\-travel and auditability

 Apache Pulsar (topics, partitions, subscriptions, geo\-replication)
   

  

 Apache Flink (stateful stream processing, windows, checkpoints)
   

  

 Apache Hudi (Merge\-On\-Read, Copy\-On\-Write, incremental processing)
   

  

 ClickHouse (real\-time analytics, high\-cardinality datasets)
   

  

 Event\-driven and streaming data architectures
   

  

 Event sourcing and state\-transition modeling
   

  

 Idempotent, replay\-safe, and failure\-tolerant data pipelines
   

  

 Designing systems for high TPS and frequent state updates
   

  

 Multi\-region data design and disaster recovery
   

  

 Secondary Skills
   

  

 Redis for low\-latency caching, counters, and ephemeral state

 Low\-Level Design (LLD) for scalable, fault\-tolerant components

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Ciklum** 
 is looking for a
 **Senior DevSecOps Engineer** 
 to join our team full\-time in India.
   

  

 We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Senior DevSecOps Engineer, become a part of a cross\-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow, responsible for architecting and maintaining the high\-security infrastructure required for an enterprise\-grade Agent Development Platform (ADP). You will be tasked with building the secure "sandbox" where autonomous agents live, ensuring zero\-trust connectivity and managing the specialized data stores that power agentic reasoning.
   

  

 You will lead the setup of the AWS production environment and the implementation of Firecracker MicroVMs to provide isolated, ephemeral runtimes for agents. You are the guardian of the platform's "Egress Controls," ensuring that while agents can reason over proprietary data, they can never exfiltrate it.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Agent Sandboxing \& Isolation: Implement and manage Firecracker MicroVMs (or restricted Kubernetes/Docker environments) to ensure agents execute in strictly isolated, secure runtimes
* Secure Data Infrastructure: Provision and optimize the platform's multi\-layered data stack, including PostgreSQL (OLTP), ChromaDB/PGVector (VectorStore), and GraphDB (Neo4j) for relational knowledge mapping
* Event Orchestration: Build and manage high\-performance Event Streams (AWS SQS, Event Bridge, or Kafka) to handle agent\-to\-agent communication and Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) escalation triggers
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Automate the provisioning of AWS cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes clusters using industry\-standard tools
* Security \& Identity Integration: Implement WorkOS/IDP for B2B identity management and multi\-tenancy, ensuring strict logical separation of tenant data and configurations
* Network Hardening: Design and enforce strict egress firewalls and proxy\-only outbound routing to prevent data exfiltration by autonomous agents


**Requirements**
* Cloud \& Containers: Deep expertise in AWS, Kubernetes, and container security; proven experience with Firecracker MicroVMs is highly desirable
* Database Management: Hands\-on experience managing and scaling Vector Databases (Chroma, PGVector) and Graph Databases for AI applications
* Security First Mindset: Strong understanding of zero\-trust architecture, OWASP principles, and secure design for AI systems
* Messaging \& Events: Proficiency in managing event\-driven architectures and streaming platforms for real\-time data processing
* Automation: Advanced scripting skills (Python, Bash) and a track record of implementing automated security gates in CI/CD pipelines
* Workflow Orchestration: Experience with Temporal for managing long\-running, multi\-stage agentic workflows


**Desirable**
* Compliance: Experience preparing infrastructure for SOC 2, ISO 27001, or GDPR readiness
* Agentic Frameworks: Familiarity with LangSmith or Langfuse for observability and tracing of agent workloads


**What’s in it for you?**
* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open\-door environment
* Growth focus: Take on large\-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company\-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company\-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial \& legal consultations


**About Us**
 At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting\-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
   

  

 India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game\-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.
   

  

**Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!**
 Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.
